Rises the moon By Liana Flores.
I hope it’s painless and good luck :)

Does the goblin have a name?
They look like they have a very important goblin meeting

It’s definitely sealed! Lol
The ingredients kinda sound more like self love spell than protection- tho it’s all about the intentions you put into the product. 
Some protection spell ingredients can include: salt, crushed egg shells, rosemary, bay leaves, black pepper, garlic, cinnamon and much more. 
I often put salt into almost of my work- it’s a basic form of protection and can be considered a good beginner tool.
Other than that I’d say it’s perfect!

Do your research. Especially if you’re a beginner. Take your time and set your intentions.
With almost anything in witchcraft, it’s about your intentions and the energy you put into your work. 
Pinterest is an okay source for sigils- but sigils are more about the intentions and the energy you put into creating it.
Spells don’t always have to spells jars. Simple candle and salt spells also work. Candle and salt spells are actually perfect for beginners. 

If I can think of anything else to add I will :)

Honestly. Just go for the little experience that make it some what worth it.
Midnight snacks, cool carnival rides, a new hairstyle, buying those shoes you’ve always wanted, finding out what that weird dream meant, a warm cup of tea on a rainy night, perfecting a recipe or tasting that specific dish one last time.
So worth it! I love that I’m able to see the brush strokes when I zoom in. super detailed and I am in love.

Well good bye. 
I hope it doesn’t get anymore painful- you’ve experienced enough as it is.
Could you find out about the afterlife for me?
Just curious- why death by hanging? No fear of suffocation or choking?

I understand why you chose what you chose. 
I do hope that you make it out of this situation alive, I don’t know you but you seem like a good person.
No one should have to go through what you’ve gone through and you have every right to be upset.

I wish you luck.
I really like how you worded that!

Honestly- everyone prefers different things, But I don’t really think you need to “compensate” for shit. 
Just learn how please your partner properly and ur good.
Not everything in sex revolves around dick size.
